units.title: Repository scaffold, packages and CI script
units.description: Read AGENTS.md first. Build exactly this work unit as defined in docs/design/LLD-v1.md section 12.3 (unit M0-01), following the LLD sections it implements (1, 12.1) and the names the LLD owns.
